budget_app.views.add_expense(request)[source]¶

Handles the creation of new expense records. Validates user input and checks if the new expense exceeds the budget threshold.

budget_app.views.add_goal(request)[source]¶

Handles creation of a new saving goal for the logged-in user. Validates the goal form and associates the goal with the current user.

budget_app.views.alerts_view(request)[source]¶

Checks the current budget cycle against the spending threshold and displays an alert message if 80% of the budget has been reached.

budget_app.views.chatbot_response(request)[source]¶

Simple rule-based chatbot that responds to keywords in the user’s message. Handles queries about budget status, expense count, and saving tips.

budget_app.views.dashboard(request)[source]¶

Main user landing page. Retrieves the current budget cycle and recent spending data to render the primary status overview.

budget_app.views.delete_expense(request, expense_id)[source]¶

Delete an expense

budget_app.views.delete_goal(request, goal_id)[source]¶

Deletes a saving goal belonging to the logged-in user. Silently ignores the request if the goal is not found.

budget_app.views.deposit_goal(request, goal_id)[source]¶

Processes a deposit toward a specific saving goal. Automatically creates a linked expense entry and marks the goal as completed if the target amount is reached.

budget_app.views.edit_budget(request)[source]¶

Allows the user to update the total budget amount for their current cycle. Redirects to setup if no active budget cycle exists.

budget_app.views.edit_expense(request, expense_id)[source]¶

Allows the user to modify an existing expense record. Recalculates the daily budget rollover after a successful update.

budget_app.views.expense_list(request)[source]¶

Displays a filterable list of all expenses for the logged-in user. Supports filtering by category, start date, and end date.

budget_app.views.export_weekly_report(request)[source]¶

Generates and returns a downloadable PDF bank statement summarizing the user’s expenses over the past 7 days, broken down by category.

budget_app.views.feedback_view(request)[source]¶

Handles user feedback submission and displays all previously submitted feedback. Saves valid feedback entries and redirects to prevent duplicate submissions.

budget_app.views.goals_list(request)[source]¶

Displays all saving goals for the logged-in user, ordered by creation date.

budget_app.views.reset_cycle_view(request)[source]¶

Deletes the user’s current budget cycle and all associated data. Redirects to the setup page to start a fresh cycle.

budget_app.views.setup_view(request)[source]¶

Renders the initial budget setup page for new users. Processes the BudgetCycleForm to create the user’s first budget cycle.

budget_app.views.signup(request)[source]¶

Handles basic user registration using Django’s built-in UserCreationForm. Redirects to the login page upon successful account creation.

budget_app.views.signup_view(request)[source]¶

Handles new user registration using the styled signup form. Logs the user in automatically upon successful registration.
